items.title: David Murray interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 18, 2003
items.q: I had to do some woodshedding with James Newton to really get my flute chops together.

ctx.x: Yeah. Okay. Well let’s talk about your progression as a musician a little bit. You had mentioned that to get into college you had to do some woodshedding with something that—

James Newton. I had to do some woodshedding with James Newton to really get my flute chops together. Because I had a flute, I played it “Memphis Underground” or something, real light kind of flute stuff. Well I mean not light but, yeah light.
Well you didn’t have to have the greatest tone and all that.
